title: fix(scripts): correct v11 to v16 in check-org-identifier self-test fixtures
body:
Fixes #9872

## Scope

Per the [2026-08-24 re-triage verdict](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/9872#issuecomment-5389636776), this card's current spec is narrowed to the **devx-owned residue only**: the four self-test fixture strings in `scripts/check-org-identifier.mjs` that still cite `v11` for the `#3290` `session.tenantId` removal, which actually shipped in **v16** (there is no `v11.mdx`; the removal is documented at `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`).

The services-owned residue (`audit-writers.test.ts:1653`) was already fixed via #11502 / PR #11543. The 11 (+2 later-found) `CHANGELOG.md` `v11` hits are **explicitly out of scope, no card** — published changelogs are append-only history, and the #9734 ruling (2026-08-22) authorized exactly one such edit and forbade a blanket sweep.

## Change

Four sites in `scripts/check-org-identifier.mjs`'s own `--self-test` fixture corpus, all comment text inside self-test *input* strings:

- `:600` — `/* session.tenantId was removed in v11 */` → `v16`
- `:604` — `// the deprecated session.tenantId alias was removed in v11` → `v16`
- `:606` — JSDoc-style block comment, same text → `v16`
- `:644` — `// sess.tenantId was removed in v11 (#3290)` → `v16`

The same file already said `v16` in two other places (header comment and `## LIVE or LATENT` section), so the inconsistency was internal to this one file.

## Verification that the edit is behaviourally inert (Zone 2)

The 2026-08-20 triage note asserted these sites are behaviourally inert ("the detector never reads version tokens; expected counts stay 0") and this dispatch required re-verifying that from the detector's own code before editing, not inheriting the note.

Read `findOffenders()` (scripts/check-org-identifier.mjs:526-557) and its two rules:

- **TEXT rule**: `PATTERN.test(code[i])` where `PATTERN = /\bsession\s*\??\.\s*tenantId\b/` and `code` is `maskComments(text)` output — comments are blanked before this rule ever sees them.
- **BINDING rule**: an AST walk (`collectBindings` / `collectBoundReads`) that only scores a `.tenantId` property-access **read** off an identifier shown to be session-provenanced. Comments are parser trivia and never enter this walk at all.

Neither rule inspects digits, version tokens, or anything besides the `session`/`tenantId` shape. All four `v11` occurrences sit inside comment text (a trailing block comment, a whole-line `//` comment, a JSDoc block, and an inline `//` comment inside a function body) — masked for the TEXT rule and invisible to the BINDING rule either way. So the digit swap cannot change which lines land in `findOffenders`'s finding map.

Confirmed empirically:

```
# before
✓ check-org-identifier self-test: 31 cases pass.
# after
✓ check-org-identifier self-test: 31 cases pass.
```

Same case count, same expected `0`s for all four cases, before and after.

## Tests

All on final commit `2ecee2b48`.

- `pnpm check:org-identifier` → `✓ check-org-identifier self-test: 31 cases pass.` / `check-org-identifier: OK (2148 author-facing source file(s), 16 session binding(s) resolved, no removed session.tenantId alias).`
- `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` → all self-test cases pass, live scan OK
- `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` → `All 116 self-test cases passed.` / `OK: 16 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared, and turbo.json hashes every declared glob.`
- `pnpm check:entry-guard` → `✓ check-entry-guard self-test: 54 cases pass ...`
- `pnpm check:parse-guard` → `✓ check:parse-guard self-test: 46 cases pass ...` / `✓ check:parse-guard: 148 scripts/ file(s) — every TypeScript parse goes through ts-parse.mjs.`
- `pnpm check:pnpm-filter-targets` → all self-test cases pass, live scan OK
- `node scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (direct, per the dispatch-derived `ci.yml` family) → same as above
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` → `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 6620 text file(s) -- 6620 tracked, 0 untracked-not-ignored; skipped 5 binary; no raw ASCII control bytes).`

Gate family derived mechanically with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no hand-written path list) against this branch's working tree: 1 path changed (`scripts/check-org-identifier.mjs`), 7 matched local gates (all run above), no changeset-triggered families apply (this is not a user-visible change — a dev-tooling self-test fixture correction — so no changeset was written and the `skip-changeset` label is applied).

Diff is exactly the 4 intended lines: `git diff --stat` → `1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)`.

## No CI issue expected

This branch is based on `origin/main` at `48318f702`, which already includes the #11808 stall-guard fix (`e75e34381`). No exit-75 observed in local runs.
